{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
data = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

# Check for -999 in biomarker_baseline
print(f"Number of -999 values in biomarker_baseline: {data['biomarker_baseline'].eq(-999).sum()}")
print(f"Proportion of -999 values: {data['biomarker_baseline'].eq(-999).mean():.3f}")

# Check for duplicate patient_id
print(f"Number of unique patient_id: {data['patient_id'].nunique()}")
print(f"Total rows: {len(data)}")
print(f"Number of duplicates: {len(data) - data['patient_id'].nunique()}")

# Check for sample_seq > 1
print(f"Number of patients with sample_seq > 1: {data.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].max().gt(1).sum()}")

# Show the first few duplicate patient_id entries
duplicates = data[data.duplicated(subset='patient_id', keep=False)].sort_values(by=['patient_id', 'sample_seq'])
print("\nFirst 5 duplicate patient_id entries:")
print(duplicates.head(5))"}
